requests.request: A 5 cm, 100 g cube rests at a random spot on a 1 m square table whose top is at z = 0.5 m; the 2-D action is a horizontal force on the cube of up to 1 N per axis, and the reward is for sliding it to a random target point on the table (success within 3 cm).
checks: rest: cube z = 0.525 +- 0.003, speed < 1 cm/s
act: constant +x action 1 s moves the cube in +x and not below the table
starts and targets differ per world and stay on the table

requests.request: A solid ball of radius 3 cm and mass 100 g starts at a random spot on a 40 cm square plate that tilts about its centre; the 2-D action sets the plate's roll and pitch rates up to 0.5 rad/s, tilt is limited to 0.3 rad, and the reward is for keeping the ball at the centre.
checks: rest: level plate, ball stays within 1 cm
act: tilt to 0.1 rad then hold: ball accelerates downhill at (5/7) g sin(0.1) = 0.70 m/s2 within 25 %
plate_rpy follows the commanded rate within 10 %, clamps at 0.3

requests.request: Ten objects (a random mix of 4 cm boxes, 2.5 cm radius spheres and 5 cm long cylinders, 50-200 g) drop into an open bin 30 cm square and 15 cm deep standing on the ground; the 2-D action moves the bin horizontally at up to 0.2 m/s, and the reward is the number of objects still inside the bin.
checks: rest (3 s): all ten inside the bin footprint, above the bin floor, below the rim, speed < 5 cm/s
no two object centres closer than 3.5 cm
act: bin moves at the commanded speed within 10 %

requests.request: A 200 g puck (a box 6 x 6 x 2 cm) starts at rest on a 15 degree incline 1.5 m long, with the puck-incline friction coefficient drawn per world from 0.1 to 0.6; the 1-D action is a force along the slope of up to 1 N, and the reward is for holding the puck at the middle of the incline.
checks: rest: worlds with friction < 0.24 slide down with acceleration g (sin 15 - mu cos 15) within 20 %; worlds with friction > 0.30 move < 5 mm in 1 s
friction values span at least 0.15-0.55 across 16 worlds
act: +1 action pushes up-slope

requests.request: Ten dominoes (each 8 mm thick, 24 mm wide, 48 mm tall, 10 g) stand in a straight row 25 mm apart on the ground; the 1-D action is a horizontal force of up to 0.5 N on the top of the first domino along the row, and success is all ten toppled.
checks: rest: all upright (tilt < 2 deg), z = 0.024 +- 0.002
act: +1 action for 0.5 s then zero: all ten tilt > 60 deg within 4 s, in order along the row
success() agrees with the tilt test

requests.request: A cart-pole: a 1 kg cart on a frictionless horizontal rail limited to +-2 m carries a 0.5 m, 0.1 kg uniform pole on a free hinge, starting within 0.05 rad of upright; the 1-D action is a force on the cart of up to 10 N, the reward is for staying upright, and the episode ends when the pole passes 0.4 rad or the cart reaches the rail's end.
checks: rest: zero action, pole falls past 0.4 rad in 0.4-3 s and done fires
act: harness state feedback (force = 10 x action, gains from the linearized model) holds |angle| < 0.2 rad for 5 s in >= 14 of 16 worlds
angle growth rate near upright matches sqrt(3 g / (2 L)) x (1 + m/M correction) within 25 %

requests.request: A double pendulum of two 0.3 m, 0.5 kg uniform rods hangs from a fixed pivot with frictionless hinges and starts at random angles within +-0.5 rad; the 1-D action is a torque of up to 2 N m at the elbow, and the reward is for swinging the tip above the pivot.
checks: rest: zero action, total mechanical energy computed from the probes drifts < 2 % over 2 s
tip_pos matches forward kinematics of joint_pos within 5 mm
act: constant +1 torque raises energy at rate torque x elbow rate within 20 %

requests.request: A door 0.8 m wide, 2 m tall and 10 kg turns on a vertical hinge with a closing spring of 2 N m/rad and damping of 1 N m s/rad, limited to 0-1.5 rad; the 1-D action is a torque of up to 3 N m on the door, and the reward is for holding it open at 1.0 rad.
checks: rest: stays closed (|angle| < 0.01)
act: constant action 0.5 (1.5 N m) settles at 0.75 rad within 5 %; action 1.0 stops at the 1.5 rad limit
release from 1.0 rad: closes without overshoot past 0, time constant consistent with I = 2.13 kg m2 within 30 %

requests.request: A Unitree Go2 quadruped starts standing on flat ground; the 12-D action offsets its joint position targets by up to 0.3 rad from the standing pose, the reward is forward speed, and the episode ends when the trunk drops below 0.18 m or tilts past 1 rad.
checks: rest: zero action stands for 3 s, trunk height 0.24-0.40 m, tilt < 0.15 rad, drift < 5 cm
act: +1 on every joint changes joint_pos by 0.15-0.35 rad
random: at least one world falls and resets to a standing pose

requests.request: A four-wheeled cart (a 30 x 20 x 5 cm, 2 kg body on four 4 cm radius wheels) drives on flat ground from a random pose; the 2-D action sets left and right wheel torques up to 0.2 N m per wheel, and the reward is for reaching a random goal within 2 m (success within 10 cm).
checks: rest: stays put (< 5 mm, < 0.01 rad)
act: equal torques drive forward along the heading (lateral drift < 10 % of distance), forward acceleration 2 x 2 x torque / (r m_total) within 35 %
opposite torques turn in place: yaw changes > 0.5 rad, position < 5 cm

requests.request: A 40 cm square, 100 g cotton cloth is held by two adjacent corners 1 m above the ground; the 6-D action moves the two held corners at up to 0.2 m/s each, and the reward is for laying the cloth flat on a table whose top is at z = 0.5 m.
checks: rest: held corners stay within 2 mm; the lowest point hangs 0.30-0.45 m below them; no point below the ground
area and edge lengths: the cloth is not stretched more than 10 % (bounding extents, corner distance <= 0.40 x 1.1)
act: corners move at the commanded speed within 10 % and the cloth follows
at least 100 cloth points

requests.request: A 50 cm square, 100 g cloth drops flat from 10 cm above a 10 cm cube that sits at a random spot on a table; the 2-D action slides the cube on the table at up to 0.1 m/s, and the reward is for keeping the cube fully covered.
checks: rest (3 s): no cloth point inside the cube by > 5 mm or below the table top by > 5 mm
cloth points above the cube's top face lie within 1.5 cm of it; points far from the cube rest on the table
the cloth is not stretched more than 10 %; settled speed < 5 cm/s
act: cube moves at the commanded speed within 15 %

requests.request: A soft silicone cube 10 cm on a side (Young's modulus about 100 kPa, density 1,100 kg/m3) sits on the ground under a rigid plate; the 1-D action moves the plate vertically at up to 2 cm/s, and the reward is for compressing the cube to 8 cm tall.
checks: rest: cube height 0.095-0.101 m, base on the ground
act: plate down 2 cm: cube top follows the plate, sides bulge outward (width grows 3-15 %), plate_force rises monotonically to 50-400 N (ideal 200 N at 20 % strain)
plate up again: height recovers to within 3 mm

requests.request: A 1 m, 50 g flexible rope hangs from a fixed point 1.5 m above the ground; the 3-D action moves a gripper that holds its free end at up to 0.3 m/s, and the reward is for bringing the rope's midpoint to a random target.
checks: rope length from the points stays 1.0 m +- 5 % in every phase
act: with the free end raised to the anchor's height 0.6 m away, the rope sags as a catenary: lowest point 0.33-0.45 m below the ends
the first point stays at the anchor within 5 mm; the end follows the command within 10 %
at least 10 rope points

requests.request: A cup holding 200 ml of water is held above a bowl; the 1-D action sets the cup's tilt rate up to 1 rad/s about its lip, and the reward is the fraction of the water that ends up in the bowl.
checks: simulated volume (points x particle_volume) is 180-220 ml
rest: >= 95 % of the water stays within the cup's start region for 2 s
act: tilt at 0.5 rad/s to 2.2 rad: >= 70 % of the water ends inside the bowl's radius and above the ground, nothing below the ground
cup_tilt follows the commanded rate within 10 %

requests.request: An open tank 20 x 10 cm in plan and 15 cm tall, half full of water, rides on a horizontal rail; the 1-D action sets the tank's acceleration up to 3 m/s2, and the reward is for moving it 1 m without spilling.
checks: simulated volume 1.35-1.65 l (ideal 1.5 l)
rest: free surface level 7.5 cm above the tank floor +- 1 cm, all water inside
act: constant 2 m/s2 for 0.5 s: the surface tilts toward the back (mean slope near a/g = 0.2, within 50 %) and the tank follows the command within 10 %
nothing passes through the walls or floor

requests.request: A tap above a cylindrical glass of 3 cm inner radius and 12 cm height pours water at a rate the 1-D action sets from 0 to 50 ml/s; the reward is for filling the glass to 8 cm and stopping without overflow.
checks: rest: zero action adds no water
act: full flow for 3 s then zero: water in the glass is 150 ml +- 20 %, level about 5.3 cm (within 1 cm), >= 90 % of emitted water is inside the glass
the amount keeps constant after the tap closes (within 3 %)

requests.request: A tray 30 cm square holds a 5 cm deep bed of dry sand, and a rigid scoop 8 cm wide moves under a 4-D action (x, y, z velocity up to 0.1 m/s and pitch rate up to 1 rad/s); the reward is the mass of sand lifted more than 10 cm above the tray.
checks: rest: bed depth 4-6 cm, nothing outside the tray or below it, settled
total sand mass 5-9 kg (bulk 1,400-1,700 kg/m3 x 4.5 l, within 20 %)
act: scoop driven 3 cm deep through the bed for 15 cm: sand ahead of it is displaced, a furrow remains whose walls hold a slope (not flat like water)
scoop follows the commanded velocity within 10 %

requests.request: A Franka Panda arm on a table lifts a 4 cm, 100 g cube that starts at a random spot in a 10 cm square in front of it; the 8-D action offsets the seven joint position targets by up to 0.05 rad per step and opens or closes the gripper, and success is the cube held 15 cm above the table for 1 s.
checks: rest: cube on the table (z = table_z + 0.02 +- 0.003), arm holds its pose (< 0.01 rad)
act: +1 on joint 1 for 10 steps turns it by 0.3-0.6 rad; gripper action opens and closes gripper_width over >= 5 cm
policy: cube >= 15 cm up for 1 s, within 3 cm of ee_pos, in >= 80 % of worlds
cube starts differ per world

requests.request: A Franka Panda arm on a table pushes a 6 cm, 200 g cube from a random start to a random target 15-25 cm away on the table; the 7-D action offsets the joint position targets by up to 0.05 rad per step, and success is the cube within 3 cm of the target.
checks: rest: cube and arm stay put
act: joint offsets move the joints as commanded
policy: cube within 3 cm of the target, still on the table and upright, in >= 80 % of worlds
the cube moves only while the arm is within 10 cm of it

requests.request: A Franka Panda arm opens a drawer with a handle in a cabinet standing 60 cm in front of it; the drawer slides 30 cm on a rail with 2 N of friction, the 8-D action offsets the seven joint position targets by up to 0.05 rad per step and drives the gripper, and success is the drawer open by 20 cm.
checks: rest: drawer closed (< 2 mm), arm holds
handle_pos moves with drawer_open one to one along the rail axis
policy: drawer_open >= 0.20 m in >= 80 % of worlds, never beyond 0.30 m
the drawer moves only while the hand is within 10 cm of the handle

requests.request: A Franka Panda arm that starts holding a 16 mm round steel peg 8 cm long inserts it into a 17 mm hole in a block fixed on the table at a random spot within 2 cm; the 7-D action offsets the joint position targets by up to 0.02 rad per step, and success is the peg 3 cm deep in the hole.
checks: rest: the peg stays in the hand (moves < 3 mm relative to ee_pos in 2 s)
hole_pos differs per world within 2 cm
policy: peg tip >= 3 cm below the hole's top, peg axis within 3 mm of the hole axis (no pass through the block), in >= 80 % of worlds

requests.request: A Franka Panda arm that starts holding a cup with 150 ml of water pours it into a bowl standing 40 cm in front of it on the table; the 7-D action offsets the joint position targets by up to 0.05 rad per step, and success is at least 80 % of the water in the bowl.
checks: simulated volume 135-165 ml
rest: >= 95 % of the water stays in the cup and the cup stays in the hand
policy: >= 80 % of the water inside the bowl in >= 80 % of worlds, nothing below the table
the cup moves with ee_pos (within 5 cm) throughout

requests.request: A Franka Panda arm pulls a 30 cm square, 50 g cloth off a 6 cm cube that it covers on the table; the 8-D action offsets the seven joint position targets by up to 0.05 rad per step and drives the gripper, and success is no part of the cloth above the cube while the cube has moved less than 2 cm.
checks: rest: cloth covers the cube (points over its top face), no penetration > 5 mm of cube or table
cloth not stretched more than 15 % in any phase
policy: no cloth point over the cube's footprint, cube moved < 2 cm, in >= 80 % of worlds
